user.title: Solar Accelerator - API Key
user.description:
Enter the API key generated in the Solar Accelerator dashboard.

Find your key at: Integrations → Inverters → Home Assistant

choose_inverter.title: Inverter - Model Selection
choose_inverter.description:
Select your inverter. Only the models below are supported for now — others require code support. Yours not listed? Let us know.

In the next step you'll pick how your inverter is exposed in Home Assistant (the source).

choose_source.title: Inverter - Data Source
choose_source.description:
How is {inverter} exposed in Home Assistant?

**Solarman / SolarAssistant** - ready-made automatic mapping.

**Manual mapping** - for a source not on the list yet; once configured you can submit it to be added.

prefix.title: Inverter - Entity Prefix

entities_pv.title: Entity Mapping - Photovoltaic Panels (PV)
entities_pv.description:
Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to PV panel data.

All entities must be mapped.

entities_battery.title: Entity Mapping - Battery
entities_battery.description: Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to battery data.

entities_inverter.title: Entity Mapping - Inverter
entities_inverter.description: Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to inverter data.

entities_grid.title: Entity Mapping - Grid
entities_grid.description: Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to grid data.

data_description.grid_power: + import from grid, - export to grid

entities_load.title: Entity Mapping - Load
entities_load.description: Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to load data.

entities_temp.title: Entity Mapping - Temperatures
entities_temp.description:
Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to temperature data.

Data will be sent automatically at every full hour.

ev_charger.title: EV Charger
ev_charger.description: Do you have an EV charger integrated in Home Assistant via OCPP?

data.ev_enabled: I have an EV charger via OCPP

ev_choose_mode.title: EV Charger - Configuration
ev_choose_mode.description:
Select how to map charger entities.

**Prefix** - automatic mapping for OCPP integration. Just provide the entity prefix (Charge Point ID).

**Manual** - manually select each entity from Home Assistant.

ev_prefix.title: EV Charger - Entity Prefix
ev_prefix.description:
Enter the charger entity prefix — this is the Charge Point ID from the OCPP integration.

Example: if your entities are named `sensor.arccharger_power_active_import`, the prefix is `arccharger`.

entities_ev_charger.title: Entity Mapping - EV Charger
entities_ev_charger.description:
Select Home Assistant entities corresponding to EV charger data (OCPP).

All entities must be mapped.

init.title: Shared devices
init.description: Manage additional controllable loads (EV charger, water heater, heat pump…) shared with Solar Accelerator. Currently configured: {count}.

export_profile.title: Report / export profile — device
export_profile.description: Enter your device details. We'll build a profile from them that you send us to add official support for your source.

data_description.source: e.g. givtcp, huawei_solar — type the new integration source name.
data_description.prefix: Common beginning of your HA entity names — replaced by the prefix variable in the profile.

profile_capabilities.title: Inverter capabilities
profile_capabilities.description: Tick the functions your inverter actually supports. This limits which control actions will be available for it.

data.grid_charge: Inverter can charge the battery from the grid
data.export: Inverter can export energy to the grid
data.soc_control: Inverter allows setting target battery SOC
data.mixed_charging: Inverter can charge from PV and grid at the same time

profile_summary.title: Summary and export

control_inverter.title: Inverter work mode
control_inverter.description: Map the entities used to control the inverter (optional). The list shows only entities of the matching type. Leave empty if your inverter doesn't have a given function.

data_description.work_mode: A select entity with the inverter work mode (e.g. Selling First / Zero Export to Load).

control_battery.title: Battery control
control_battery.description: Map the entities used to control the inverter (optional). The list shows only entities of the matching type. Leave empty if your inverter doesn't have a given function.

data_description.battery_max_charge_current: A number entity setting the battery charge current limit in amperes.
data_description.battery_max_discharge_current: A number entity setting the battery discharge current limit in amperes.

control_grid.title: Grid control
control_grid.description: Map the entities used to control the inverter (optional). The list shows only entities of the matching type. Leave empty if your inverter doesn't have a given function.

data_description.grid_peak_shaving: A switch entity that turns grid peak shaving on/off. This is an on/off toggle, NOT a power value.

control_pv.title: PV control
control_pv.description: Map the entities used to control the inverter (optional). The list shows only entities of the matching type. Leave empty if your inverter doesn't have a given function.

data_description.pv_power_limit: A number entity limiting PV power in watts.

control_schedule.title: Schedule (TOU)
control_schedule.description: Map TOU schedule entities (optional). SLOT 1 is enough — slots 2–6 are generated from the pattern. The list shows multiple entity types (time may also be a number).

data_description.tou_1_time: A time entity — start time of schedule slot 1.
data_description.tou_1_soc: A number entity — target battery SOC in slot 1 (percent).
data_description.tou_1_charge_mode: A select entity — charge source in slot 1 (e.g. Grid / Generator / Off).
data_description.tou_2_time: A time entity — start time of schedule slot 2.
data_description.tou_2_soc: A number entity — target battery SOC in slot 2 (percent).
data_description.tou_2_charge_mode: A select entity — charge source in slot 2 (e.g. Grid / Generator / Off).
data_description.tou_3_time: A time entity — start time of schedule slot 3.
data_description.tou_3_soc: A number entity — target battery SOC in slot 3 (percent).
data_description.tou_3_charge_mode: A select entity — charge source in slot 3 (e.g. Grid / Generator / Off).
data_description.tou_4_time: A time entity — start time of schedule slot 4.
data_description.tou_4_soc: A number entity — target battery SOC in slot 4 (percent).
data_description.tou_4_charge_mode: A select entity — charge source in slot 4 (e.g. Grid / Generator / Off).
data_description.tou_5_time: A time entity — start time of schedule slot 5.
data_description.tou_5_soc: A number entity — target battery SOC in slot 5 (percent).
data_description.tou_5_charge_mode: A select entity — charge source in slot 5 (e.g. Grid / Generator / Off).
data_description.tou_6_time: A time entity — start time of schedule slot 6.
data_description.tou_6_soc: A number entity — target battery SOC in slot 6 (percent).
data_description.tou_6_charge_mode: A select entity — charge source in slot 6 (e.g. Grid / Generator / Off).

control_extra.title: Additional control entities
control_extra.description: Pick control entities that didn't fit any field above — e.g. a second charge-mode switch (separate grid and gen). We'll assemble them into the profile.
